messages.subject: Hartnell - settlement cost-to-company breakdown
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Attached is the cost-to-company breakdown at £247,500. Net to Geoff is about £145k after PAYE on the taxable element; total cost to the Company is about £281k once employer NIC above the £30k threshold, the PMI continuation and the costs contribution are added. I've kept the £30k tax-free element on the standard ss.401-403 basis - we should flag to Karen that the PILON-equivalent portion is taxable.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
